## Browse by Special


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

base_dir <- "."

# Find immediate child directories
md_dirs <- list.dirs(
  path = base_dir,
  recursive = FALSE,
  full.names = FALSE
)

# Remove folders that should not become dashboard cards
excluded_dirs <- c(
  "index_files",
  "_site",
  "_freeze",
  ".quarto",
  "Images",
  "images"
)

md_dirs <- md_dirs[
  !startsWith(md_dirs, ".") &
    !md_dirs %in% excluded_dirs
]

md_dirs <- sort(md_dirs)


# Find the docs folder regardless of capitalisation
find_docs_dir <- function(md, base_dir = ".") {

  md_path <- file.path(base_dir, md)

  if (!dir.exists(md_path)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  child_dirs <- list.dirs(
    md_path,
    recursive = FALSE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  docs_match <- child_dirs[
    tolower(basename(child_dirs)) == "docs"
  ]

  if (!length(docs_match)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  docs_match[1]
}


# Find the main HTML dashboard
find_dashboard_html <- function(docs_dir) {

  if (is.na(docs_dir) || !dir.exists(docs_dir)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  html_files <- list.files(
    docs_dir,
    pattern = "\\.html$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  if (!length(html_files)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  # Prefer index.html where available
  index_file <- html_files[
    tolower(basename(html_files)) == "index.html"
  ]

  if (length(index_file)) {
    return(index_file[1])
  }

  sort(html_files)[1]
}


# Find the probability plot thumbnail
pick_md_thumb <- function(md, base_dir = ".") {

  docs_dir <- find_docs_dir(md, base_dir)

  if (is.na(docs_dir) || !dir.exists(docs_dir)) {
    return("Images/champions-league-ball.png")
  }

  # Convert:
  # "MD 2 Preview" -> "MD-2-Preview"
  # "CLMD 2"       -> "CLMD-2"
  dashboard_stem <- gsub("\\s+", "-", trimws(md))

  # Possible Quarto support-folder formats
  possible_folders <- c(
    paste0(dashboard_stem, "---Dashboard_files"),
    paste0(dashboard_stem, "-Dashboard_files"),
    paste0("-International-break-", dashboard_stem, "-Dashboard_files")
  )

  # Possible spellings/file names
  possible_image_names <- c(
    "Match Result Probablity Plot-1.png",
    "Match Result Probability Plot-1.png"
  )

  # First try the expected paths directly
  for (support_folder in possible_folders) {

    for (image_name in possible_image_names) {

      candidate <- file.path(
        docs_dir,
        support_folder,
        "figure-html",
        image_name
      )

      if (file.exists(candidate)) {

        relative_path <- file.path(
          md,
          basename(docs_dir),
          support_folder,
          "figure-html",
          image_name
        )

        return(gsub("\\\\", "/", relative_path))
      }
    }
  }

  # Fallback: recursively search all generated image folders
  image_files <- list.files(
    docs_dir,
    pattern = "\\.(png|jpg|jpeg|webp)$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  probability_plot <- image_files[
    grepl(
      "Match[ _-]*Result[ _-]*Probab.*lity[ _-]*Plot",
      basename(image_files),
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ]

  if (length(probability_plot) > 0) {

    relative_inside_docs <- substring(
      probability_plot[1],
      nchar(docs_dir) + 2
    )

    relative_path <- file.path(
      md,
      basename(docs_dir),
      relative_inside_docs
    )

    return(gsub("\\\\", "/", relative_path))
  }

  "Images/champions-league-ball.png"
}


# Extract a readable subtitle from the dashboard HTML
extract_subtitle <- function(html_path) {

  x <- tryCatch(
    readLines(
      html_path,
      warn = FALSE,
      encoding = "UTF-8"
    ),
    error = function(e) character(0)
  )

  if (!length(x)) {
    return("Open matchday dashboard")
  }

  txt <- paste(x, collapse = "\n")

  # First try the HTML title
  m <- regexpr(
    "(?is)<title>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*</title>",
    txt,
    perl = TRUE
  )

  if (m[1] != -1) {

    title <- sub(
      "(?is).*<title>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*</title>.*",
      "\\1",
      regmatches(txt, m),
      perl = TRUE
    )

    title <- gsub("\\s*\\|\\s*.*$", "", title)
    title <- gsub("\\s*-\\s*Quarto$", "", title)
    title <- trimws(title)

    if (nzchar(title)) {
      return(title)
    }
  }

  # Fall back to the first H1
  m2 <- regexpr(
    "(?is)<h1[^>]*>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*</h1>",
    txt,
    perl = TRUE
  )

  if (m2[1] != -1) {

    h1 <- sub(
      "(?is).*<h1[^>]*>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*</h1>.*",
      "\\1",
      regmatches(txt, m2),
      perl = TRUE
    )

    h1 <- trimws(h1)

    if (nzchar(h1)) {
      return(h1)
    }
  }

  "Open matchday dashboard"
}


cards <- vapply(md_dirs, function(md) {

  docs_dir <- find_docs_dir(md, base_dir)

  if (is.na(docs_dir)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  full_html_path <- find_dashboard_html(docs_dir)

  if (is.na(full_html_path)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  # Preserve the actual docs folder capitalisation
  docs_name <- basename(docs_dir)
  html_file <- basename(full_html_path)

  rel_path <- file.path(md, docs_name, html_file)
  rel_path <- gsub("\\\\", "/", rel_path)

  # URLencode = TRUE ensures spaces become %20
  url <- utils::URLencode(
    rel_path,
    reserved = TRUE
  )

  subtitle <- extract_subtitle(full_html_path)
  thumb <- pick_md_thumb(md, base_dir)

  # Encode thumbnail paths containing spaces
  thumb_url <- utils::URLencode(
    gsub("\\\\", "/", thumb),
    reserved = TRUE
  )

  sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6 g-col-lg-4">\n',
      '  <div class="card season-card">\n',
      '    <div class="season-card-media">\n',
      '      <img src="%s" class="card-img-top img-fluid" alt="%s thumbnail">\n',
      '    </div>\n',
      '    <div class="card-body">\n',
      '      <h3><a href="%s">%s</a></h3>\n',
      '      <div class="text-muted">%s</div>\n',
      '    </div>\n',
      '  </div>\n',
      '</div>\n'
    ),
    thumb_url,
    htmltools::htmlEscape(md),
    url,
    htmltools::htmlEscape(md),
    htmltools::htmlEscape(subtitle)
  )

}, character(1))


cards <- cards[!is.na(cards)]

output <- paste0(
  '<div class="grid">\n',
  paste(cards, collapse = "\n"),
  "\n</div>\n"
)

knitr::asis_output(output)
```
